nodes.title: Note: ref2va workflow
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 ref2va (WSL 16GB)

Fixes the identity drift of `minimax_h3_i2v_wsl_turbo`: the identity photos are re-injected at **every step and every frame**, instead of only the frame-0 keyframe.

**Inputs**
- **Start frame** -> `ref_image_0` = `<Picture 1>` **and** `Add Guide` at frame 0 (exact start). Bypass the Add Guide node to follow the official template instead (start driven by `<Picture 1>` + prompt only).
- **Identity refs** -> `<Picture 2..4>`: face close-up, full body, another angle. Clean, sharp, well-lit photos of the **same** person work best. More slots appear on the node (up to 9 images). Every connected image must be named in the prompt.
- `ref_image_size`: `match` (fast). Try `max` (2048px short edge) for stronger identity if VRAM/time allow.

**Prompt**: use the official ref2va sections (`subject_definitions`, `summary`, `retention_analysis`, `detailed_description`, `overall_soundscape`, `non_diegetic_music`). Call her `<Subject 1>` everywhere and keep `retention_analysis` marking her as `fully_preserved`. No negative prompt (cfg 1).

**Speed**: Turbo off = 20 steps (best identity). Turbo on = official `ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1` LoRA, 4 steps (fast, weaker reference adherence).

**LoRAs**: the Civitai LoRAs were trained on the fl2va checkpoint; the bypassed experimental node lets you try one on ref2va (~0.5).

Launcher: `mauro-files/run-minimax.sh`. Models: `mauro-files/download-minimax.sh`.

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face:Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**ModelScope mirrors** (alternative repo location)

- [ModelScope:Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://modelscope.cn/models/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (2.62 GB)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) (577.2 MB)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (19.53 GB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (14.61 GB)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.82 GB)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>. <Picture 2> shows her face, <Picture 3> her full body and <Picture 4> another angle of her; together they define her exact facial features, skin tone, hair, body shape and proportions.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> in the starting pose, clothing, location and lighting of the video.

summary:
[first frame + reference generation] The video starts exactly from <Picture 1> and follows <Subject 1> in a single continuous shot. Her identity from <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4> stays consistent until the very last frame.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, facial proportions, skin tone, hair, body shape and body proportions match <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4> in every frame, from the start to the end of the video, including in side views and close-ups.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the video starts exactly from <Picture 1>'s framing, pose, clothing, background and lighting.
<Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, <Picture 4> (identity references): partially_preserved - only the identity of <Subject 1> is taken from them, not their background, clothing or framing.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action footage.

[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. Describe the action here, always calling her <Subject 1>.

overall_soundscape:
Soft ambient environmental sounds matching the location in <Picture 1>.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
